objectives.name: the relay mast
objectives.text: Get past the Static's relay mast

radio.line: Warehouse roofs. Static use 'em for lookouts. Head down, keep moving.
Ladies, gentlemen, and... whatever the rest of you are. Our courier has left the building!
His name's Parker. Runs for a living. Today? Running for love. Ugh, I know. Parker, darling, you're on the air.
Let's make it interesting, folks. Bets are open. My money says he's in the Silt by lunch.
Two walls up ahead. Run the first, then jump and kick off the second one. Wall hop.
Lookouts! Boys, say hi to the man of the hour.
Three gunners. Red laser on you means a shot's coming, so move. And if it gets busy, click the mouse wheel. Slows everything down for a few seconds.
Oh, he shoots too! Echo, sweetheart, you never told me that.
That mast's their relay. Get past it and they lose you. Wall's on your left this time.
He's quick, folks! Quicker than the last three couriers I had. Rest in pieces, boys.
Don't go anywhere. Coming up, the Glass District. Mind the windows. And my toll boys. They bite.
Don't listen to him. Breathe. Then we go.
That was an expensive drone, Parker! That's going on your tab.

bail.line: Ooh! That one's going in the highlights.
Ooh. Hear that, folks? Pretty sure that was his pride.
Down he goes! Echo, you married this?

combo.line: Look at him go! Echo, you watching this? Oh, right. You're tied up.
Moves like that, I might have to start paying him.
The phones are ringing off the hook! Okay, we don't have phones. But they would be.

fall.line: And he's down! Little dust bath for our boy.
Back up you go. Don't give him the satisfaction.

kill.line: Good lookout, that one. Looked out for about a second.

down.line: And our courier's taking a nap! Somebody get the man a pillow.
Up. Don't stand there in their sights. Run, then shoot.

radio.line: Barriers. Jump right into 'em and you'll vault without losing speed.
Too wide to jump. Wall on the right, like back home.
